p1: True Developments is a Monterrey-based real estate developer with more than 18 years of experience developing distribution facilities, industrial buildings and industrial parks in Mexico.
p2: We design, build and operate reliable industrial spaces, where companies operate with certainty and where people and communities thrive.
p3: Our portfolio exceeds 100,000 m² of owned properties leased to companies such as PepsiCo, Vitro, Nemak and Mission Foods, plus more than 200,000 m² built for clients including HEINEKEN México, Caterpillar, Henkel, Polaris and other leading companies.
